calls.thesis: CONDITIONAL_BUY — SOFT FLIP (was BUY 2026-02-25): likes Marvell for custom silicon + connectivity and believes it is a $400 stock over the next two years, but 'use patience rather than jumping right in' after +200% in 12 months / a big past-month run.
calls.base_case: Models value ~$280, about where it trades; analyst PT $340; FY28 revenue outlook raised to ~$20B at investor day, custom chip revenue ~$12B projected for FY29.
calls.bull_case: Earnings expected +48% this year then +70% in each of the next two years; data centre was 79% of revenue ($2.2B, +46% YoY) in fiscal Q2; Celestial AI optical acquisition adds connectivity upside.
calls.bear_case: Projections depend on product execution, customer demand and manufacturing capacity; valuation full after the run — wait for a better entry.
calls.flip_note: Soft flip: was BUY on 2026-02-25, now CONDITIONAL_BUY — still bullish long-term ($400 over 2 years) but explicitly patient at current prices after a 200%+ run.

calls.thesis: Overvalued vs his $200 DCF fair value; already benefiting from AI spend but valuation has run ahead of fundamentals. Not interested in owning anywhere near current prices.

calls.video_title: If You Missed NVIDIA, Jensen Just Showed Us What's Even Bigger (3 Stocks to Buy Now)
calls.thesis: Top of Luke Lango's shopping list; AI safety push shifts compute focus from pre-training (GPUs) to inferencing, where networking and custom silicon are the buildout bottlenecks — both Marvell strengths; chart rebounding above the 200-day MA.
calls.bull_case: Safety vertical adds more networking/custom-silicon demand to the data-center buildout.
